Name: Younger Pam - Moth's Vanilla Facelift-style Portraits
Author: mothbeanie
Description:
A retexture of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8147]A Younger Pam[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/57059532]Ebu[/url] to match the style of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7116]Vanilla Facelift[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/67968777]siamece[/url]. Portraits only.

For [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher[/url]. You do not need to also have A Younger Pam installed when using this.
